_comment: Fixed reference scales and constraint bounds for the surrogate optimisation.

objective_reference_scales._comment: Ranges used to normalise each objective to a comparable [0,1] scale before weighting.
objective_reference_scales._source: Computed from pairwise_outcomes.pkl — spans the full output variation observed across all 2-policy combinations at varying intensities, covering the space from no-policy baseline to maximum single/pair-policy intensity.

bo_weights._comment: Relative importance of each objective in the acquisition function scalarisation. Equal weights = treat a 1-unit-of-range improvement in utility the same as 1-unit-of-range reduction in emissions or cost.
